notes.title: Major Patch V3.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452858/5151cd327b9f7487bd9061b8d8f12681d35f35d3.png"][/img]
A new secret stage titled ''Subaquatic'' and boss is now available, only accessible in Hypermode.

A new secret weapon has now been added to the game.

Life extends through scoring are now less frequent across game sessions.

Bug fix: Artifact at the end of stage 7 no longer has a hitbox/can't hurt the player.

Bug fix: Boss 7 spiral-ball attacks no longer overlap in Hypermode if damaged too quickly.

Minor Patch: The Tri-beam has been nerfed, again (this thing does way too much damage)

Minor Patch: The red enemy aircraft bullets are now a brighter orange for more visibility.

Hard mode changes:

Player starting lives are set to 5 instead of 11

reduced the amount of lives pickups.

Increased the amount of secret crystals in later hypermode stages.



[/p]

notes.title: Patch 2.9.1 Minor patch + Hotfix!
notes.content:
[b]Aspect Ratio has been forced to 16/9 in order to stop the second menu from breaking.
Steamdeck/Proton users should now not run into any issues.
[/b]
[b]Boss 3 side shots have now been nerfed in normal mode, speed remains the same in Harder difficulty[/b]

If the bug with Steamdeck persists, and that the second main menu doesn't function, please inform me about it and I'll do my best to try to repair it.

Thank you for your patience! Sorry for any inconvenience!

notes.title: Patch 2.9 Minor changes
notes.content:
[b]Secret weapon tri-beam has been slightly nerfed[/b]

[b]Visual layer bug with the emergency screen on stage 4 has been patched[/b]

[b]End credits are now skippable[/b]

[b]A new secret weapon has been added to the game![/b]

Hope everyone has had a great weekend so far, enjoy these new updates.
Happy shmupping!

notes.title: Patch 2.8 Minor Changes
notes.content:
[b]Slight bullet speed reduction adjustment for enemies in normal mode from stage 3-5[/b]

[b]Player bomb damage and weapons damage have been scaled up slightly[/b]

[b]Boss 3 slight pattern adjustment[/b]

[b]Exploding enemy mines projectile speed reduced slightly[/b]

That's all the updates for today :)

notes.title: Patch 2.7 asset cleanup
notes.content:
Various unused assets and placeholder pictures that took space have been cleaned to further attempt in making performance and loading times go faster, I will investigate further.

That's all for now, and yes I'm going through possible issues as fast as possible.
Thank you for your patience, have a nice weekend.

Magnaremora signing out!

notes.title: Patch 2.6 minor changes
notes.content:
[b]Trimmed down some assets that took up space and weren't used,
Hopefully, this will fix performance issues and loading time.[/b]

[b]Difficulty modified for hard mode and hyper mode[/b]

That's all for now! Keep on shmupping, guys :D

notes.title: Patch 2.5 minor changes
notes.content:
[b]Lesser live drops in Hard mode[/b]

[b]Player Bombs damage nerfed from 1800 to 1600[/b]

[b]Endgame boss health pool slightly bigger[/b]

[b]Discord functionality in the main menu is now operational![/b]

Thanks everyone for staying patient and enjoying the game!
Magnaremora signing out!
